RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 5

The person appointed is a woman, as are you. An all-woman panel choosing a woman over another woman tells us nothing about sex bias against you — there is no comparator of a different sex to point to. Raising it would likely read as grievance-hunting and undermine the legitimate complaint you do have.

That complaint is substantive: on paper you appear better credentialled (PhD vs master's, nine years' modelling experience vs "broad regulatory experience"), and they have ignored a reasonable request for written reasons for two weeks. Chase that in writing, to HR, with a deadline, citing their own recruitment policy. Ask for scoring against the published criteria. Age could be a factor worth watching — but you have no evidence yet.
